greet.speaker: Clerk
lines: You are not on the visitor list.
The budget office is busy. What do you want?

choices.text: Ask about the road project budget

budget.speaker: Clerk
lines: I should not say this, but the ledger does not match the announcement.
Here, take this page. Please do not tell anyone where you got it.

approver.speaker: Clerk
lines: Everything is signed by the deputy director.
That is all I am allowed to say.

already_gave.speaker: Clerk
lines: I already gave you that page. Please leave before someone sees us.

greet.speaker: Janitor
lines: Mind the wet floor. I clean this lobby every night.

choices.text: Ask what he saw last night

saw.speaker: Janitor
lines: A man left his phone in the meeting room, still open on his messages.
I printed them out. Someone should read them, and it should not be me.

lobby.speaker: Janitor
lines: Marble floors, no budget for new mops. Funny, that.

already_gave.speaker: Janitor
lines: You have the printout already. Be careful with it.

greet.speaker: Archivist
lines: Records Room. Everything here is filed, dated and signed.

choices.text: Ask for the Spokesperson's original statement

file.speaker: Archivist
lines: The Spokesperson's original statement is filed here. His public version quotes only half of it.
Read the whole thing. Take a copy.

records.speaker: Archivist
lines: Every record has an author and a date. A record with neither is not a record.

already_gave.speaker: Archivist
lines: You already have a copy of that statement.

greet.speaker: Intern
lines: Please do not tell my boss I am talking to you.

choices.text: Ask about the department's social media

social.speaker: Intern
lines: Most of our 'supporters' are accounts we made ourselves. I keep the list.
I copied it for you. I did not know where else to take it.

coffee.speaker: Intern
lines: It has been broken since March. Nobody is allowed to say so.

already_gave.speaker: Intern
lines: You have the list. Please keep my name out of it.

greet.speaker: Poll Worker
lines: Polling station. Are you here to vote, or to ask questions?

choices.text: Ask about the envelopes by the door

side.speaker: Poll Worker
lines: You get a paper ballot, mark it in secret, and drop it in the box.
Nobody is allowed to look. That is the whole point.

main.speaker: Poll Worker
lines: Those envelopes arrived before dawn, one for every name on a list.
I am not paid enough to keep this quiet. Take them.

again.speaker: Poll Worker
lines: You already have the envelopes. Please go before the manager sees you.

greet.speaker: Student Volunteer
lines: Hi! I am volunteering for the campaign. Well, I was.

side.speaker: Student Volunteer
lines: Banners, snacks, and rides to the polls. That part is normal and honest.

main.speaker: Student Volunteer
lines: They told us to hand out cash, but only to people who showed a photo of their ballot.
I kept the receipts they made us sign. I cannot stop thinking about it.

again.speaker: Student Volunteer
lines: You have my receipts. I hope they help.

greet.speaker: Booth Attendant
lines: Keep moving, please. One person per booth.

side.speaker: Booth Attendant
lines: Curtains are there so nobody can see your vote. Or sell it.

main.speaker: Booth Attendant
lines: The 'poll' asked only people already on the campaign's list.
A fair poll picks people at random. The desk in the east room holds the proof.

greet.speaker: HR Clerk
lines: Personnel Office. Applications are processed strictly by the book.

choices.text: Ask about the new Chief of Staff

side.speaker: HR Clerk
lines: Every job is posted, every applicant is scored, and the best score is hired. That is the rule.

main.speaker: HR Clerk
lines: The new Chief of Staff is the Director General's nephew. There was no interview.
Here is his file. I filed it myself, and it has bothered me ever since.

again.speaker: HR Clerk
lines: You have the file already. Please be careful with it.

greet.speaker: Rejected Applicant
lines: I came here three times. They keep saying the job was filled.

side.speaker: Rejected Applicant
lines: Polite smiles and no answers. I think the decision was made before I applied.

main.speaker: Rejected Applicant
lines: I placed first on the original list. The person they hired was last.
I kept my copy of the original ranking. Take it.

again.speaker: Rejected Applicant
lines: You have my copy. Please use it well.

greet.speaker: Auditor
lines: I am auditing this office. Please do not touch the folders.

side.speaker: Auditor
lines: Salaries are paid from public money. Every name on it should do real work.

main.speaker: Auditor
lines: Several relatives of the Director General are paid for jobs that have no duties.
The records are on the desk in the east wing. Compare them yourself.
